# Content Backlog — what is missing, and in what order

**Version:** v0.72.0 · Generated by `coverageBacklog()` in
`coverageMatrix.ts`. Not maintained by hand.

---

## Why this is derived and not written

A hand-kept backlog forgets things by omission: a record left out of an edit
simply never appears, and nobody notices because nothing is missing from the
list — the list is the only thing anyone checks.

This one is computed from the registry. Every primary-verified official record
without complete, reviewed content produces an entry. **The moment a pending
class becomes verified, all of its records appear**, without anyone
remembering to add them. A test asserts the entry count equals the registry's
own record count for verified classes.

Not authoring. **All nine Chapter 7 sections are authored and eight are
complete instructional drafts.** They need a Grade 6 mathematics educator to
read them.

§7.9 is the one incomplete draft: one worked example where two are the minimum,

## What P2 and P3 are not

They are not a plan. Listing 80 records that need Learn content is a
description of the gap, not a commitment to fill it, and filling P2 before P1 is
reviewed would mean authoring 56 more sections in a format no educator has yet
approved.

The ordering above says: **finish reviewing what exists before writing more.**
